promos_value_check.name: promos_value_check
promos_value_check.value: ("promos"."kind" = 'percent' and "promos"."value" is not null and "promos"."value" between 1 and 10000) or ("promos"."kind" = 'fixed' and "promos"."value" is not null and "promos"."value" > 0) or ("promos"."kind" = 'free_delivery' and "promos"."value" is null)

promos_limits_check.name: promos_limits_check
promos_limits_check.value: "promos"."min_order_minor" >= 0 and ("promos"."max_discount_minor" is null or "promos"."max_discount_minor" > 0) and ("promos"."max_redemptions" is null or "promos"."max_redemptions" > 0) and ("promos"."max_per_customer" is null or "promos"."max_per_customer" > 0)

promos_window_check.name: promos_window_check
promos_window_check.value: "promos"."starts_at" is null or "promos"."expires_at" is null or "promos"."expires_at" > "promos"."starts_at"
